# RDFLib

![](../../assets/3rdparty/images/RDFLib-250.png)

[RDFLib](https://rdflib.dev), is python package used to create and manipulate [Resource Description Framework (RDF)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Resource_Description_Framework) data. 

## RDFLib links

* [RDFLib's home on GitHub](https://github.com/RDFLib/rdflib/) - for developers
* [RDFLib on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/rdflib/) - for Python users
* [RDFLib's documentation website](https://rdflib.readthedocs.io/)
* [RDF Dataset example](https://github.com/RDFLib/rdflib/blob/main/examples/datasets.py) - as this has proven hard to find

KurrawongAI staff have been core contributors to RDFLib for 8 years and currently lead the maintenance of it.

## Recent applications

!!! note

    We maintain the [kurra](/products/tools/kurra/) toolkit we use for many manual and infracode RDF management tasks. It is built on top of RDFLib, as is [PrezManifest](/products/tools/prezmanifest), our RDF DB management tool and [pyLODE](/products/tools/pylode) the opne source ontology/vocabulary documentation tool we use

* training for the [ICSM ANZ Address Model](https://kurrawong.ai/services/training#address-model-training) which used RDFLib to manipulate RDF data
* lectures over several years at the Australian National University for the IT Masters course [COMP 7230](https://github.com/nicholascar/comp7230-training/) on Semantic Web / Linked Data creation and use
* implementing Python client libraries for [GraphWise's](https://graphwise.ai) [GraphDB](https://graphwise.ai/components/graphdb/) application
* building the [Prez](/products/prez) Linked Data application

## Services Offered

Due to our long and current engagement with RDFLib, we can:

* build custom data Knowledge Graph and web applications 
    * including web APIs, UIs, ETL code, infracode
* develop RDFLib for clients' use
* support any aspects of RDFLib use
